what_it_is: The SI-Bone iFuse INTRA Ti is a 3D printed minimally invasive titanium implant desined for use in the posterior percutaneous stabilization and fusion across the SI joint. If features a 3D iFuse lattice intended to improve bony adherence along with cutting blades and bone anchors to grip and compress across the SI joint. The implant featrues fenestrations to allow ingrowth of bone as well.
indications: Minimally invasive SI joint stabilization and fusion.
use_notes: Simple technique designed for reproducible placement. Compared favorably vs competitor rectangular ridged allograft in biomechanical testing (Technical Study 301310-TS). Increases biomechanical stabilization.
